{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|gr1= DLC

|descr= Returns array of app IDs of DLCs.

|s1= [[getDLCs]] filter

|p1= filter: [[Number]] one of:
* 0 - all
* 1 - owned
* 2 - not owned

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Number]]s - App IDs

|x1= <sqf>_ownedDLCs = getDLCs 1;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_hasKarts = (288520 in (getDLCs 1));</sqf>

|seealso= [[getObjectDLC]] [[getPersonUsedDLCs]] [[getMissionDLCs]] [[getDLCAssetsUsageByName]] [[getDLCAssetsUsage]] [[getAssetDLCInfo]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Benargee
|timestamp= 20150407202700
|text= App ID can be found in CfgMods. Here is an example path from zeus using the Splendid Config Viewer:
<sqf>configFile >> "CfgMods" >> "Curator" >> "appId"</sqf>
This method can be used to find app IDs without having to find a list like the one above.<br>
I am also pretty sure you are able to define your own app ID for your own mods using this method.
}}
